fusions.name: Heartwood Maul
fusions.desc: A two-pawed blow that deals 34 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Stripped to Sapwood
fusions.desc: A raking weapon strike that deals 4 damage, strips 5% of the target's armour for 3 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lie Dormant
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You also restore 15 health.

fusions.name: Winter Girth
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and your armour rises by 6%.
